title: aloe perfoliata var. depressa
intro: Aloe perfoliata var. depressa, commonly known as 'Flat Aloe', is a succulent plant species belonging to the Aloe genus, characterized by its flat, round leaves and short stature. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Aloe perfoliata var. depressa are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to calm and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of this plant include aloin, aloe-emodin, and other anthraquinones, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
